question: Which word is the closest synonym for "uplift" as used in the passage?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Improve.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"uplift"** means:

 
 
• To raise to a higher level; to improve the condition of something or someone. (सुधारना)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The community project aims to uplift the standard of living in the neighborhood.
 
• **"Correct answer"** means:
 
 
• Referring to the specific answer that properly defines or fits the context of the question. (सही उत्तर)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The correct answer to the quiz question assured him a perfect score.

Therefore, the closest synonym for "uplift" is: **Improve**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Depress** (उदास करना): To make someone feel sad or disheartened.

 
 
• **Example:** The constant bad news began to depress everyone in the office.
 
 
 
• **Decrease** (कम करना): To reduce in size, number, or amount.
 
 
• **Example:** The company decided to decrease its production due to low demand.
 
 
 
• **Interrupt** (बाधित करना): To stop the continuous progress of an activity or process.
 
 
• **Example:** The speaker paused to let the applause interrupt his speech.
